minor_issues.issue: 化合物 1 C-27 化学位移描述中将 H-1‴ (D-Api) 端基的 J = 2.0 Hz 耦合常数误归于 C-27 末端亚甲基质子 (5.09 m)
minor_issues.source_locator: 草稿报告第五节(一)结构鉴定 / Table 1 Pos 27 与正文第 2 页
minor_issues.correction: 原文 [δH 5.09 (1H, d, J = 2.0 Hz, H-1‴)] 为 D-Api 端基信号；C-27 末端亚甲基实为 δH 5.09 m + 4.99 s (原文未给出具体 J 值)，应避免把 Api 端基 J 值叠加到 C-27 上。

minor_issues.issue: 化合物 1 物理外观在 Results 部分描述为 'yellow amorphous powder'，Experimental 部分描述为 'White, amorphous powder'，原文内部存在不一致
minor_issues.source_locator: 原文第 2 页 (Results) 与第 8 页 (Experimental, polypharycoside A)
minor_issues.correction: 草稿仅采用 '白色无定形粉末'（与 Experimental 一致）；可在报告中简要注明原文中此不一致。

minor_issues.issue: Figure 9 y 轴标签写为 'Log PFU/ml'，但细菌模型应为 Log CFU/ml（原文内部笔误）
minor_issues.source_locator: 原文第 7 页 Figure 9 / 实验 4.13 节 (1 × 10⁸ PFU/sample)
minor_issues.correction: 草稿均使用 CFU/mL，与正文一致；建议在引用 Figure 9 时备注 'Log PFU/ml' 系原文轴标签，文中以 CFU/mL 为准。

verified_claims.source_locator: 原文 PDF 第 5 页 §2.2
verified_claims.evidence: only compound 8 (MIC = 64 mg/L) and compound 10 (MIC = 128 mg/L) exhibited weak antibacterial activity against S. typhimurium

verified_claims.evidence: a quasi-molecular ion peak was observed at m/z 1085.4773 [M + Na] + (calculated for C50H78O24Na, 1085.4775)

verified_claims.evidence: DP4+ probability analysis revealed exceptional agreement between theoretical and experimental chemical shifts, with 99.99 % confidence for compound 2 and 100 % for compound 3

verified_claims.claim: 生长曲线：≥2×MIC 处理后 OD600 峰值降至对照的 15.8% (2×MIC) 和 5.8% (4×MIC)

verified_claims.evidence: the OD600 peaks dropped to 15.8 % (2 × MIC) and 5.8 % (4 × MIC) of the control, demonstrating a concentration-dependent bactericidal effect

verified_claims.claim: 抑菌圈直径 7.5 mm (0.5×MIC) → 22.0 mm (2×MIC) → 25.0 mm (4×MIC)
verified_claims.source_locator: 原文 PDF 第 5 页 §2.4
verified_claims.evidence: the diameter of the zone of inhibition increased from 7.5 mm ... to 22.0 mm at 2 × MIC with only a slight increase to 25.0 mm at 4 × MIC

verified_claims.source_locator: 原文 PDF 第 6 页
verified_claims.evidence: 1.5 × MIC group: OD260 = 0.134 and OD280 = 0.154 at 12 h

verified_claims.claim: ATP 在 4×MIC 处理 2 h 内下降约 85%
verified_claims.source_locator: 原文 PDF 第 7 页 Conclusion
verified_claims.evidence: rapid ATP depletion (85 % reduction at 4 × MIC within 2 h)

verified_claims.source_locator: 原文 PDF 第 6 页 §2.7 / Conclusion
